module: "Occupant head" camera (driver or passenger, cockpit view) defined by the vehicle's jbeam. The camera follows a head node with an adjustable blend of static position / physics (setting cameraDriverPhysics), locks horizon and pitch (cameraDriverStableHorizon/Pitch), anticipates the turn (look-ahead, "stone on a string" algorithm), lets you turn the head up to 160 degrees (yaw) and ±80 (pitch), lean over the shoulder (shoulderLeft/Right profiles) and adjust the seat (tilt -30 to 20 degrees, y and z position limited to ±0.4 m), saved per vehicle in the 'cameraDriverVehicleConfigs' setting. Handles the driver zoom (DriverCameraZoom) and the VR options (snap turn, horizon lock). Returns a constructor.
notes: jbeam fields used: seatSide ('left'|'right'|'center'), seatId, shoulderLeft/shoulderRight (startYaw, lateralOffset, forwardOffset, verticalOffset, forwardMultiplier, verticalMultiplier), lookBack{side, yaw}, idRefOccupant/idLeftOccupant/idBackOccupant, camNodeID, refNodes.
During the first 3 frames after a configuration change (cameraResetted), update only places the camera on the vehicle (unreliable data) and returns nothing.

Settings read: cameraDriverPhysics, cameraDriverAutocenter, cameraDriverAllowSeatAdjustments, cameraDriverStableHorizon, cameraDriverStablePitch, cameraDriverLookAheadAngle, cameraDriverLookAheadSmoothness, cameraDriverFov, openXRsnapTurnDriver, openXRhorizonLockDriver.
A FIXME comment in the code notes that camPosInitialLocal can be computed at any time (for example after damage).

C.desc: Occupant camera mode. Fields: camRot, relativeYaw/Pitch, seatPosition (vec3), seatRotation (degrees), manualzoom, occupantDetached, icon 'personSolid', canUseVehicleTriggerCrosshair = true.

init.desc: Creates smoothers, shoulder profiles and parameters, then calls onVehicleCameraConfigChanged and onSettingsChanged.

onVehicleCameraConfigChanged.desc: Hook: resets the seat position and the occupant reference nodes; will reload the seat config on the next update.

onOccupantDetached.desc: Hook: the occupant is detached (break group "ocpAttach<seatId>"): the camera will follow the occupant nodes.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: the vehicle has been repaired, the occupant is no longer detached.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook: on focus gain pushes the "DriverCameraZoom" action map; on loss, removes it and resets the driver zoom to 0.

focused.desc: true if the mode takes focus

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: re-reads the cameraDriver* and OpenXR settings.

resetSeat.desc: Resets the seat (position, tilt) to zero for this vehicle and saves it immediately.

resetSeatAll.desc: Resets the seat to zero and clears the seat config of all vehicles (cameraDriverVehicleConfigs = {}).

reset.desc: Recenters the head, resets the sway and the driver zoom to zero.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: after extensions reload, reloads the config and resets.

update.desc: Computes head position and orientation and the FOV, handles seat adjustment and delayed saving (1 s), writes data.res.

data.desc: camData (data.driverZoom, data.lookBack, data.player, data.speed, data.fastSpeedModifier read)

setRefNodes.desc: Sets the reference nodes; if any of the three is nil, uses the idRef/Left/BackOccupant nodes.

mouseLocked.desc: Indicates whether the mouse is locked or not; on unlock with auto-recentering and the vehicle moving, recenters the head.
